argv: import subprocess; values=[int(x) for x in subprocess.check_output(["ps","-axo","rss="], text=True).split()]; print(f"TOTAL_RSS_GIB={sum(values)/1048576:.3f}; THROTTLE_GIB=14; HEAVY_COVERAGE=BLOCKED")
command.display: uv run python -c import subprocess; values=[int(x) for x in subprocess.check_output(["ps","-axo","rss="], text=True).split()]; print(f"TOTAL_RSS_GIB={sum(values)/1048576:.3f}; THROTTLE_GIB=14; HEAVY_COVERAGE=BLOCKED")

notes: Heavy package coverage is prohibited while aggregate RSS is at or above 14 GiB; no threshold or numeric coverage is invented.
